2608.09876.title: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
2608.09876.paper_summary: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit. Therefore, they fail to form reusable physical knowledge, which compromises reliability in unpredictable open-world navigation. To address this, we propose a novel Energy-Structured Latent World Model (ELWM). Our key idea is to structure the ELWM latent state to explicitly carry energy and momentum, ensuring strictly causal transitions via dissipation and control ports. Trained on multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories, our model guarantees physically consistent predictions. We further implement this for motion planning by constructing Physics-Conditioned Neural Time Fields (PC-NTF), a key technical cornerstone that integrates ELWM into an arrival time field via the Eikonal equation to yield a physically-informed navigation policy. Across held-out scenes, our evaluation reveals significant improvements. Compared to generic latent models, PC-NTF reduces 0.8-s motion-prediction NRMSE from 0.36 to 0.29. Against Active Neural Time Fields, it improves navigation success from 81.3% to 89.7% and SPL from 0.64 to 0.73, while cutting the physical collision rate from 12.1% to 5.8% and the Eikonal residual from 0.083 to 0.031. Beyond these targeted gains, our results demonstrate that embedding explicit physical structures into latent spaces intrinsically bridges the gap between predictive world models and safe, dynamically feasible motion planning.
2608.09876.paper_summary_zh: 在具身人工智慧中，物理一致的運動規劃仍然是一個基本挑戰，因為生成的軌跡必須嚴格符合現實世界的執行動力學。雖然潛在世界模型通過預測這些動力學提供了一種有前景的方法，但現有方法學習的未來表示是無約束的，其中吸收的物理學仍然是隱含的。因此，它們無法形成可重用的物理知識，這在不可預測的開放世界導航中妨礙了可靠性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種新穎的能量結構潛在世界模型（ELWM）。我們的關鍵想法是將ELWM潛在狀態結構化，以明確攜帶能量和動量，通過耗散和控制端口確保嚴格的因果轉換。在多模態RGB-D和慣性互動歷史上訓練，我們的模型保證了物理一致的預測。我們進一步通過構建物理條件神經時間場（PC-NTF）來實現這一點，這是一個關鍵的技術基石，通過Eikonal方程將ELWM整合到到達時間場中，以產生物理知情的導航策略。在保留的場景中，我們的評估顯示出顯著的改進。與通用潛在模型相比，PC-NTF將0.8秒的運動預測NRMSE從0.36降低到0.29。與主動神經時間場相比，其導航成功率從81.3%提高到89.7%，SPL從0.64提高到0.73，同時將物理碰撞率從12.1%降低到5.8%，Eikonal殘差從0.083降低到0.031。除了這些針對性的增益，我們的結果表明，將明確的物理結構嵌入潛在空間本質上彌合了預測世界模型與安全、動態可行的運動規劃之間的差距。
